# TypeScript examples

Run the package's first-install steps before using an example. See the repository [example guide](https://github.com/jabdori/maxt/blob/main/docs/examples.md). Public reads run normally; credentialed reads require a read-enabled account; request-only examples do not submit financial writes.

## Run the first public read

From a repository or package checkout, run:

```text
node examples/binance-public-ticker.mjs
```

| Task | Safety | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read public market data | public read | [binance-public-ticker.mjs](binance-public-ticker.mjs) |
| Read candles and paged history | public or credentialed read | [candles-history.mjs](candles-history.mjs) |
| Receive public and account streams | public read or credentialed read | [streams.mjs](streams.mjs) |
| Read balances, rules, and asset configuration | credentialed read | [account-and-safety.mjs](account-and-safety.mjs) |
| Inspect and validate order workflows safely | request only or credentialed read | [account-and-safety.mjs](account-and-safety.mjs) |
| Inspect transfers and wallet configuration | credentialed read or request only | [account-and-safety.mjs](account-and-safety.mjs) |
| Read funding, positions, and margin | public or credentialed read | [derivatives.mjs](derivatives.mjs) |
| Use Binance Spot, USD-M, and wallet APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [binance-provider.mjs](binance-provider.mjs) |
| Use Upbit region and provider-specific APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [upbit-provider.mjs](upbit-provider.mjs) |
| Use Bithumb market, KRW, and TWAP APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [bithumb-provider.mjs](bithumb-provider.mjs) |
| Use Hyperliquid market and address-scoped Info APIs | public or address-scoped read | [hyperliquid-provider.mjs](hyperliquid-provider.mjs) |
| Use public reads in a browser and route signed calls through a relay | browser boundary | [browser-relay.mjs](browser-relay.mjs) |
